title: How to Trust: Part 1
fullTitle: Soul Snack #47: How to Trust: Part 1
description: Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Sense? Learn How Here.
Trust is often viewed as something you place in others – your partner, your job, your children’s well-being – what if the deepest kind of trust isn’t about the outside world at all?

In this powerful episode, Gary Zukav invites us to rethink trust as a spiritual practice, one that begins not with certainty about the external, but with radical acceptance of everything – inside and out- as a pathway to our spiritual growth.

Through personal reflection, Gary explains how a frightened part of your personality pursues external power by attempting to control outcomes and avoid pain. But as he shares, true trust is found in releasing that need for control and making the responsible choice to act from a loving part, even while the painful energy of a frightened part is active.

The path to authentic power is paved with trust: trusting that every experience is here to serve your soul’s evolution . This episode offers a profound reminder that choosing love – no matter what – is the most courageous and transformative act we can take.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:
(00:00) – Two Worlds, One Choice: Gary introduces the choice we face in every moment: to live in love or fear—and how this defines our experience of trust.
(01:12) – You Can’t Control Anyone: We often try to trust people or circumstances, but Gary reminds us that control is an illusion—and surrendering it opens the door to real trust.
(01:50) – What Can You Trust?: Learn why trusting that everything (inside and outside) is for your benefit is essential to your spiritual growth.
(02:42) – Recognizing the Frightened Parts: From anger and jealousy to addiction and compulsion, Gary explores how fear-based reactions reveal where we are not trusting life.
(04:38) – The True Meaning of Authentic Power: Discover how choosing love in every moment—no matter what—is the key to aligning your personality with your soul.

Reflect on a moment when you felt anxious, reactive, or out of control. What were you trying to resist or change? This week, when you notice yourself slipping into fear or judgment, pause. Ask yourself: “What would love do right now?” Practice trusting that what’s happening is here to support your growth – and choose love, no matter what.
